papers.label: LSE100
lines: LSE100 is a half unit taken by all students, running across Autumn and Winter Terms in the first year. The course provides one of the marks that is eligible to be included in the calculation of the First Year Average for purposes of classification.
Students will choose ONE of the three half-unit options below:
LSE100A The LSE Course: How can we transform our climate futures? (0.5)
LSE100B The LSE Course: How can we control AI? (0.5)
LSE100C The LSE Course: How can we create a fair society? (0.5)
